name: MonarchLifecycleBadge
title: LifecycleBadge
summary: The release stage of an API, SDK or feature (planned, preview, stable, deprecated) or a custom stage, as a quiet capsule with a coloured dot and a text label.
whenToUse: Beside the name of an API, an SDK, an endpoint or a feature to say how far it is in its lifecycle, or for a custom stage such as a customer's lifecycle stage.
whenNotToUse: For a status such as Draft or Overdue use MonarchBadge. For an HTTP method use MonarchMethodBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchLifecycleBadge(lifecycle: MonarchLifecycle, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone? = null, showDot: Boolean = true, label: String? = null)
@Composable fun MonarchLifecycleBadge(stage: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone? = null, showDot: Boolean = true, label: String? = null)
enum class MonarchLifecycle(val key: String) { Planned, Preview, Stable, Deprecated }

options.name: lifecycle
options.description: The built-in stage: Planned, Preview, Stable or Deprecated.

options.name: stage
options.description: In the second overload, the key of a stage. One of the four built-in keys, matched exactly, is drawn as that stage; any other key is neutral and shown as readable text unless label and tone are given.

options.name: tone
options.description: Replaces the tone of the stage: planned neutral, preview info, stable success, deprecated warning, anything else neutral.

options.name: showDot
options.description: Whether the dot before the label is drawn.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in label (monarch_lifecyclebadge_planned, _preview, _stable, _deprecated). Already localised.

states.name: default
states.description: Not interactive; one look per tone.

states.name: without dot
states.description: showDot = false leaves the bordered capsule and the label.

appearance: A capsule on the surface color with default text and a 1dp border; the tone is only in the border (the tone's border role) and the dot (its strong role). Neutral uses the default border and the subtle text color for the dot, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchBadge as the base. MonarchBadge colors its text with the tone and has no dot, so this component draws the web's quieter look from the same tone palette, as iOS does. The web's accent tone is not offered because MonarchTone has no accent case; the web's sm size is not offered: the label is the caption role and follows the font size setting. The web's messages map is the label parameter and the string resources. The web's dot prop is showDot; iOS calls it showsDot.
accessibility: Read by TalkBack as its label; the dot has no semantics, so the label carries the meaning without the color.
The label and the dot grow with the font size setting.
Not interactive: it has no click action and no touch target.
edgeCases: A stage key the app does not know is shown as the key with underscores and hyphens turned into spaces and a capital first letter; that text is not localised.
Keys are matched exactly: "Stable" is not the built-in stage stable.
An empty key with no label draws a capsule with only the dot.
Long labels wrap inside the capsule.
